notes: Black Friday offer ads in the user's Comfort Wear BF template (research/bf_theme_reference.webp): black spotlit stage, gold/black balloons, white BLACK + red FRIDAY, red banners. Offer: Buy 1 Get 1 Free; Buy 2 Get 2 Free + 2 Free Gifts. Replaces the earlier white/red/gold rule.

concepts.angle: Exact template layout: podium hero with the two-tier offer
concepts.headline: BLACK FRIDAY · BUY 1, GET 1 FREE
concepts.prompt: At the top, huge white condensed caps "BLACK" and directly under it huge red caps "FRIDAY". Below, a round glossy black podium holding two pairs of Cloog slippers from the reference sheet, one dusty rose pink pair and one sage green pair. Under the podium, a wide red banner with huge white caps: "BUY 1, GET 1 FREE". Under it, two black bars each with a red plus square: "BUY 2, GET 2 FREE" and "+ 2 FREE GIFTS". Nothing else. Comfort Wear Black Friday theme (match it exactly): a glossy black studio stage lit by two bright spotlights from the top corners that make the scene glow, so it reads premium and well-lit, not murky; floating metallic gold and glossy black balloons with thin gold strings at the sides; black gift boxes with gold ribbons and a few gold confetti flecks on the floor. Typography: massive bold condensed sans-serif caps, white for 'BLACK' and bright red (#E10600) for 'FRIDAY' and key offer words; offer lines sit in solid bright-red rectangular banners with white bold caps, and secondary lines sit in black bars with a red square holding a white plus sign at the left. The slippers are brightly lit and the hero of the frame.
